Compute all same-source one-step peaks arising from overlapping (including nested) occurrences of any pair of left sides. Each critical pair is joinable iff its two descendants share at least one reachable normal form under the same rules. Because every rule strictly shortens finite words, termination is proved by exact length. Then all critical pairs joinable is equivalent to confluence of the entire finite string rewrite relation (critical pair criterion + Newman's lemma). Return CONFLUENT or a concrete NONCONFLUENT witness: source, two branches, and separately reachable normal-form sets with empty intersection. Wording does not imply that a nonconfluent ruleset lacks individual common normal forms for other starting words.

Every incompatible ordered pair of subterms becomes one fresh hole; equal ordered disagreement pairs reuse the SAME hole, even in disjoint branches. A different arity or constructor is a disagreement. Fresh holes are numbered by first depth-first left-to-right appearance. A non-ground input, binder, improper term or unbounded depth is BLOCKED. This operation is not unification and never claims a physical .sens semantics.

Given finite trace of states and pure total boolean predicate P, return least index i where P(state_i)=NO, or ALL-PASS if none; preserve zero-based index.
For finite state sequence using explicit equality, collapse each maximal consecutive run of identical states to one, preserving order and nonconsecutive repeats.
For finite DNF consisting of conjunctions of positive Boolean atoms, remove any term whose literal set strictly contains another; retain sorted inclusion-minimal terms.
For finite exact rational input x and finite nonempty impulse response h, return causal zero-extended convolution y[n]=sum_i h[i]x[n-i], n=0..len(x)+len(h)-2 when x nonempty.
For finite exact rational word x of length n, output r[k]=sum_{i=0}^{n-1-k}x[i]x[i+k] for k=0..n-1; never wrap around.
For two equal nonempty rational cyclic words x,y of length n, define r[k]=sum_i x[i]y[(i+k) mod n]; return all n lags.
Represent polynomials as finite bit coefficient vectors over GF(2). For nonzero divisor d, compute unique remainder r of degree less than deg d such that a=q*d+r using xor arithmetic.
For finite rectangular 0/1 matrix, return number of linearly independent rows over GF(2) computed by XOR row reduction.
For nonempty width-n state s and a specified n-bit tap mask t, emit the low output bit s[n-1] and next state (xor of selected tapped bits, s[0],...,s[n-2]); fixed convention is shift right.
For binary matrix H with n columns and binary word x of n bits, return syndrome H*x modulo 2 using XOR sums.
For any exact rational cycles q, return unique exact phase q-floor(q) in [0,1); preserve correct behavior for negative q.
Given nonempty rational samples x, positive integer input/output rates a,b and output indices j where floor(j*a/b)<len(x), return y[j]=x[floor(j*a/b)] exactly.
For sorted distinct rational times t_i and rational samples x_i, interpolate on interval [t_i,t_(i+1)] by exact affine interpolation; outside domain returns OUT-OF-RANGE.
Given strictly increasing rational edges e_0..e_m and finite sample x with every x in [e_0,e_m), count each sample in unique half-open bin [e_i,e_(i+1)); sorted bins.
On a well-formed De Bruijn term, increment every free variable index k>=cutoff c by nonnegative delta d, increasing cutoff when entering each binder; bound indices below local cutoff unchanged.

For a De Bruijn lambda term with a closed replacement term R, substitute the index-0 variable under a lambda body using index lifting appropriate to binder nesting; no free capture is possible since R is closed.
Parse two first-order lambda terms with explicit lexical scope into canonical De Bruijn forms; return YES iff forms are structurally equal, ignoring bound-variable names but not free-variable names.
Given two total DFAs on same finite alphabet, BFS their product from start-state pair and return shortest lexicographically least word on which acceptance differs, or EQUIVALENT if none.
Given finite DFA with total transitions, return induced reachable-state automaton and old-to-new state map under canonical BFS traversal order; accepted language unchanged.
For finite context-free grammar, compute least fixed-point FIRST sets of possible leading terminals and separately epsilon possibility for each nonterminal; reject undefined symbols.
For finite nonempty set of distinct binary codewords with no empty codeword, return YES iff no word is a proper prefix of another; otherwise witness shortest lex-conflicting pair.
For finite multiset of positive codeword lengths l_i, return exact rational K=sum_i 2^(-l_i); do not claim K<=1 unless prefix-free code existence is being tested.
Given exactly n bits in {0,1}, serialize groups of up to 8 in MSB-first order padding only the final partial byte with zeros, and return original bit length n as metadata.
Given a byte vector plus original bit length n within 0..8*bytes and zero-valued padding bits, reconstruct the first n bits MSB-first; reject nonzero padding.

Map Unicode-equivalent representations to canonical NFC/NFD forms while preserving semantic equivalence for downstream transliteration.

Fill unspecified name/type/host/device/version from explicit defaults; relative directory values concatenate with default directory, preserving component semantics.
Wildcard match is directional; a wildcard in the first pathname matches only a wildcard in the second; actual matching mechanics implementation-defined.
Represent a claim/result together with the explicit assumption chain on which its validity depends, preserving provenance rather than treating the result as floating authority.
Parse a structured text query, apply field/tag/date restrictions, compute text relevance, emit ordered results with snippets and pagination totals.
At each input position choose the longest defined mapping key starting there, with token-kind context for marks/consonants.

Apply a finite rewrite table where the result for a matched input depends on lexical context classes such as word-start and after-consonant, with deterministic longest-key matching and case projections.

Отримати початкову функцію, навіть коли її обгорнуто; базова функція лишається відмінною від wrapper chain.

Given an n×n symmetric covariance matrix Sigma and an m×n Jacobian J at the same linearization point, yield m×m J*Sigma*transpose(J), retaining nonzero cross-covariances; reject inconsistent shapes.
